g.text: , the agent made two processes write
: the web worker and a cron job. It wrapped the
Without the lock, both processes can read the old file, change
it, and write it back. The second write silently drops the first
: the kernel only tracks who holds the
lock. It does not stop a process that never asks for it. It works
because every writer agrees to take it first.
Cheap and simple, and the lock is released when the process dies.
Only protects cooperating code. Not reliable on NFS.
For more writers, a real database is the next step.
